If We Cannot Even Keep Marijuana From Prisoners On Death Row….

(Marijuananews note: This short article demonstrates the absolute absurdity of marijuana prohibition. Turning DEAland into one vast Gulag is not going to make marijuana prohibition work. It is a counterproductive fraud.)

October 27, 1999

Drugs Get Into Death Row
From The ABC NewsWire on Yahoo
Montgomery, Alabama

An autopsy on death row inmate Brian Baldwin after his electrocution earlier this year has revealed that he used marijuana sometime within a few days of his death.

 The state crime lab says that's a first for the state. Corrections Department spokesmen say drugs are always a problem in the prison system and that occasionally guards can be bribed if enough money is offered. Two unidentified guards at Holman prison, where death row is located, were under suspicion as drug smugglers even before Baldwin's autopsy. One was fired when caught with contraband and the other resigned when it became evident that he was a suspect.
